title: Main frame initialization
statement: For a natural number $F$, the instruction sequence sets the frame pointer to the negative of the pool value at index twice the main-frame base, initializes the $F$ main-frame stack registers to zero, and copies the first two argument registers into the stack registers at offsets one and two from the main-frame base.
